notes:
# v1.4.8 - Indonesian Hits covers fit, reader restores to the panel you left

- Fixed: the Indonesian Hits row on Home no longer shows cropped or zoomed
  covers. That row's sources return cover art with different proportions, which
  the shared card style was centre-cropping; the covers are now shown in full on
  those cards.
- Fixed: the reader now reopens on the panel you left on. Leaving mid-chapter
  and coming back used to land on the last panel and then jump to the next
  chapter; the saved position is now tracked per chapter and restored to the
  correct panel, and the automatic next-chapter jump no longer fires while the
  position is being restored.
- Note: no action needed on your part - just update and enjoy.
